title.narrative: Advancing Political Pluralism and Transparency in Sri Lanka and the Maldives (APPT)

description.narrative:
The global objective is to protect human rights, fundamental freedoms and democracy in Sri Lanka and in the Maldives.

The specific objective is to enhance democratic governance in Sri Lanka and Maldives, with a specific focus on improving the integrity, transparency, and accuracy of electoral processes, and supporting political pluralism and inclusiveness.
